Speak\_ was founded in 2021 by Andrea Guendelman in Boulder, Colorado. The company’s core mission is to enhance diversity in tech recruitment by providing a comprehensive platform for tech interview preparation, coding assessments, and curated resources. Speak\_ aims to streamline the hiring process for recruiters while promoting unbiased candidate evaluations. Their services cater to both hard and soft skill development, ensuring candidates are well-prepared for interviews at top tech companies.

Notable figures affiliated with Speak\_ include founder Andrea Guendelman, who has a strong background in diversity initiatives. The company has garnered attention for its innovative approach to reducing unconscious bias in recruitment through custom signal settings. Speak\_ has made significant strides in the tech recruitment space, helping numerous candidates secure positions at leading tech firms and contributing to a more inclusive hiring landscape.
